info.title: Workeasy Campaign API
info.description: Browser API. Cookie session + X-CSRF-Token on state-changing requests. Errors use one shape (Error). Organization/workspace routes answer 404 to non-members and 403 to members lacking the permission.

get.summary: Readiness probe: PostgreSQL and (durable mode) the job queue, with latencies; 503 while a dependency is down or the process is draining
Prometheus metrics (text format). Requires Authorization: Bearer METRICS_TOKEN; the route does not exist without one. Counts and latencies only — no ids, no personal data

get.summary: Meta webhook subscription handshake (WhatsApp): returns hub.challenge as text when hub.mode=subscribe and hub.verify_token matches WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN

429.description: rate limited: 60 per IP per minute

post.summary: Delivery feedback from a configured provider: mailgun (email: delivered, deferred, hard bounce, complaint, unsubscribe, open, click), twilio (SMS status callbacks: delivered, failed; and replies to the SMS number: STOP withdraws the SMS consent of the contact where the number was texted, START undoes only that — answered with empty TwiML), whatsapp (Meta statuses: delivered, read, failed; failure 131050 withdraws the WhatsApp consent of the contact). Signature verified over the raw body; each signature token accepted once per body; tenant resolved from the provider message id; events deduplicated by provider event id. Responds with counts only

401.description: signature invalid, stale, or replayed with another body

404.description: no such provider, or webhooks not configured
